name: PANTHER Family Causal Bridge (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when Chemical causally affects regulator in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The drug target belongs to the PANTHER gene family The pinned descendant closure is biolink:member_of. At least one primary source must be infores:panther. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The distinct disease-associated gene belongs to the same PANTHER family The pinned descendant closure is biolink:member_of. At least one primary source must be infores:panther. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control. The drug target and disease gene must be different nodes.
hypothesis: A curated target in the same evolutionary gene family as a distinct disease gene may share disease-relevant function.

nodes.explanation: Drug-engaged upstream gene or gene product.

mechanism.rationale: A curated target in the same evolutionary gene family as a distinct disease gene may share disease-relevant function. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[target_member:{{relationship_types:target_member}}]->(family:GeneFamily) WHERE target_member.predicate IN {{predicates:target_member}} AND any(source IN ["infores:panther"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target_member.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[disease_member:{{relationship_types:disease_member}}]->(family:GeneFamily) WHERE disease_member.predicate IN {{predicates:disease_member}} AND any(source IN ["infores:panther"] WHERE source IN coalesce(disease_member.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} AND (regulator<>gene) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT family) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; target_member: enforce primary-source membership in infores:panther; disease_member: enforce primary-source membership in infores:panther; The drug target and disease gene must be different nodes.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Shared evolutionary family does not establish equivalent function, tissue expression, or regulatory direction.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
